skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.keen_timing.de: Your parry windows widen, rank by rank, back to the old ones: perfect 0-3, 0-4, 0-5 ticks from the raise, a parry up to 8, 10, 12.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.snatch.desc: A perfect parry with bare fists takes the foe's weapon straight into your empty hand instead of dropping it. Every Monk has it; the Thief's tree has it too.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.iron_guard.des: A held guard costs 0.4 half-feathers per point of damage instead of 0.6.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.snatch.desc: A perfect parry with bare fists lifts the foe's weapon straight into your empty hand. Counts as Strength's Snatch.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.discipline.locked.arm: %s: locked (a veteran guard of the drill yard teaches it)
gui.jaymoskingdoms.discipline.locked.ki: %s: locked (the Fist school's master teaches it)
talkwheel.jaymoskingdoms.jaymoskingdoms_: Teach me to defend myself your way.
discipline.jaymoskingdoms.teach.arms.tau: Feet set, blade up before you think of it. Again. Again. There: now it's yours, and the yard will do the rest.
discipline.jaymoskingdoms.teach.arms.poo: Thirty silver for the yard's time. Come back with it.
discipline.jaymoskingdoms.teach.arms.kno: Your guard comes up already. Go and use it.
discipline.jaymoskingdoms.teach.ki.taugh: Breathe in, and let the blow find stone where it looked for flesh. You have the start of it.
discipline.jaymoskingdoms.teach.ki.poor: The school asks thirty silver. Bring it, and we begin.
discipline.jaymoskingdoms.teach.arcana.t: A turning, not a wall: the blow slides off the shape you hold. Practise it, and it will come quicker.
discipline.jaymoskingdoms.teach.arcana.p: Thirty silver, and I'll show you the turning.
discipline.jaymoskingdoms.teach.arcana.k: You ward already. There's nothing I can add.
